displayName: System-chain UC-04B R2 Web auth projection regression
notes: Request-bound verifySessionCookie repair is reviewer-accepted as unit-proven (12/12 focused Vitest, clean tsc). The one authorized Playwright invocation failed under mixed 127.0.0.1/localhost dev-host evidence. Reviewer trace inspection rejected browser cookie-loss attribution: the browser navigation used 127.0.0.1 and carried the session cookie, but emitted no client auth/jobs fetch after page load.

findings.summary: Auth.js callback handling inside page.request crossed from 127.0.0.1 to localhost, while the later browser navigation stayed on 127.0.0.1 with its session cookie but emitted no client auth/jobs fetch; the Operations role remained anonymous_local.
findings.nextAction: Run one fresh localhost-normalized regression under a successor packet; do not mutate next.config.ts from the rejected browser cookie-loss diagnosis.
